steps.text:
The knit vase is built in the Knit vase design, and its check passes against the plan: watertight, 90 mm wide, 160 mm tall, 2 mm floor, open top.

The texture is an approximation. A real knit stitch isn't a shape these tools can make, so I used 72 vertical grooves (wales) about 4 mm apart around the outside, each 1 mm deep. The grooves are the guessed part, along with the 2 mm floor and 4 mm spacing you confirmed on the sheet as guesses.

**Your 2 mm wall:** the grooves cut into the wall, so the groove bottoms are only 1 mm thick. If you want a true 2 mm minimum under the texture, I can make the wall 3 mm, or make the grooves shallower (about 0.5 mm, which leaves 1.5 mm). I haven't changed it yet.

Also, PLA prints can weep through layer lines over time. For water, consider sealing the inside with epoxy or a food-safe coating, or print in a thicker wall.

I haven't sliced or sent anything to the A1 mini. Tell me which wall option you want, and I'll slice it for the A1 mini and then queue it when you say so.
